logs.title: CASE 01 // Assignment
logs.body:
BLACKWATER MUNICIPAL EMERGENCY AUTHORITY

You have been contracted to audit station BCR-17 following several missed operator check-ins.

The station's automated broadcasts continue to appear in the monitoring network. However, recent archive records contain unexplained discrepancies.

Your assignment is to reconstruct the station's final transmissions, preserve relevant recordings, and identify the source of the irregularities.

Operator: Elias Venn
Station: BCR-17
Location: Blackwater Coastal District
Case status: OPEN

logs.title: CASE 01 // Station handover
logs.body:
BCR-17 operates as a coastal weather and emergency broadcast station.

Routine broadcasts include weather reports, navigation notices, and scheduled time signals.

The station's archive is incomplete. Preserve every relevant transmission before drawing conclusions.

logs.title: EQUIPMENT INVENTORY // Cabinet 4B
logs.body:
An older spectrum analyzer was removed from the main receiver console during the last equipment replacement.

Inventory indicates that the analyzer and its service documentation remain in cabinet 4B in the signal room.

The equipment has not been checked out.

logs.title: CASE 02 // Preliminary instruction
logs.body:
The archive timestamps must be checked against an independent reference signal.

Do not assume that the station's clock and the reference clock are synchronized.
